title: Naruto to Boruto: Shinobi Striker patch 2.72 adds Kabuto Yakushi (Sage Mode) as playable Master Character

sources.note: Bandai Namco page dated 12 Nov 2026: Master Character Training Pack #50 adds Kabuto Yakushi (Sage Mode), third Master Character of Season Pass 10 (packs #48 to #51); 'Upon release, all players will have access to him as a playable character'; Deidara and Konan attack changes; Body Activation 5 to 10 s; platforms PS4, Xbox One, Steam
Steam: official 5th Anniversary Opening Trailer, used as footage

first_report: 2026-11-12 (Bandai Namco news page, listed in the server digest seq 382, 14:52Z); no Arabic outlet seen
gate: gate 15:50Z: Bandai Namco page read in full, no Update/Correction note, no denial; digest 19:23 lists no change

angle.hook: Kabuto in Sage Mode is now a playable Master Character in Shinobi Striker
angle.why_now: Patch 2.72 went up on Bandai Namco's page on 12 Nov
angle.what_it_means_here: Naruto is hugely popular with Arab players, and everyone gets Kabuto on release with no purchase wording on the page beyond Season Pass 10
angle.payoff: Deidara and Konan attacks change and Body Activation doubles to 10 seconds

story_items.update: change: Kabuto (Sage Mode) added with patch 2.72; demonstration: official anniversary trailer is illustration only; effect on play: Deidara clay detonation, Konan paper shuriken, Body Activation 5 to 10 s; availability: PS4, Xbox One, Steam; date and time not stated
